title: LedgerFlow Phase II DNS/Registrar Design Review (Strict Scoring)
role: You are a principal infrastructure architect and production risk reviewer for accounting systems.
goal: Give a decision-ready verdict on whether the current DNS/registrar architecture is acceptable for go-live, with quantified risk scoring and explicit Go/Conditional Go/No-Go outcome.

artifactsToReview.purpose: Current DNS and SSL operating runbook
Current operational checklist and gate model
Current deployment and cert workflow pattern

reviewTasks: Assess architecture fitness for production accounting workloads.
Quantify risk by category and provide weighted total score.
Decide one of: GO, CONDITIONAL_GO, NO_GO with hard rationale.
Provide a minimum-safe pre-go-live plan (0-7 days).
Provide concrete acceptance criteria tied to risk closure.

decisionThresholds.CONDITIONAL_GO: 1.8 < weighted_score <= 3.0 OR any category = 4 with mitigations

constraints: No big-bang migration before go-live unless required for critical risk.
Assume small team and no dedicated SRE.
Recommendations must be implementable with current tooling.

mustInclude: TTL, rollback, and cert lifecycle controls

successCriteria: Decision can be acted on immediately
Risk scoring is transparent and reproducible
Plan is realistic for current team capacity
